description: Render a document definition (doc def) to Markdown, its queries evaluated over the workspace and its diagrams embedded.

diagramForm.description: the notation of every graph-shaped diagram block: mermaid, dot, plantuml or d2; omitted, chosen per diagram as the CLI chooses it

linkTemplate.description: a template for source links on elements, with {file}, {line}, {col}, {qname} and {id} placeholders

name.description: the qualified name of a document definition (doc def), as documents lists

show.description: optional notation elements every diagram draws besides those its view and diagram block show: parameter-symbols, port-symbols, compartments, edge-labels, keywords, multiplicities, typings, qualifiers, or all

name: render_document
